summary: Push A day. Breakfast and pre-workout are quick protein-smoothie-plus-grab items for zero prep. Lunch brings in Mary's Free Range Chicken Bowl for variety after the last few days of turkey-and-pasta and sticky/spicy chicken plates, topped with extra chicken breast and black beans. Dinner is a new main too - Blackened Chicken Breast Sandwich - with extra chicken breast, black beans and pasta to round out protein, fiber and carbs.
